fields.label: Depth effect
fields.description: Draw the clock behind the wallpaper's foreground. Turn off to keep the mod installed without the effect.

fields.label: Clock format
fields.description: How the time is written. Pick Custom to use your own format below.

fields.label: Custom format
fields.description: Only used when Clock format is Custom. Qt format letters: HH hour (24h), h hour (12h with AP), mm minutes, ss seconds, AP for AM/PM, ddd or dddd weekday, d day, MMM or MMMM month. Put literal text in single quotes. Example: ddd d MMM HH:mm

fields.label: Font
fields.description: Name of an installed font family, for example Inter or JetBrains Mono (run fc-list : family to see what you have). Leave empty for the default font. A name that isn't installed falls back to the default.

fields.label: Font weight
fields.description: Thickness of the clock text. If the font doesn't have the chosen weight, the nearest one it has is used.

fields.label: Clock size, percent of screen height
fields.description: Height of the clock text relative to the screen.

fields.label: Clock color
fields.description: Auto picks light or dark text from how bright the wallpaper is behind the clock. The other options force one color, or follow your theme.

fields.label: Clock position
fields.description: Where the clock sits on the screen. Use the offsets below to nudge it from there.

fields.label: Horizontal offset, percent of screen width
fields.description: Moves the clock sideways from the chosen position. Negative is left, positive is right.

fields.label: Vertical offset, percent of screen height
fields.description: Moves the clock up or down from the chosen position. Negative is up, positive is down.

fields.label: Foreground threshold
fields.description: How close something has to be to count as foreground, from 0 to 100. Lower values cut out more of the scene. Changing this reuses the cached depth map, so it is fast.

fields.label: Edge softness
fields.description: Blur radius in pixels around the cutout edge, from 0 (hard) to 50 (very soft).
